title: Pasta e Ceci Soup
subtitle: chickpea and pasta soup
description: A rustic Italian soup of chickpeas, tomatoes and rosemary, partly blended for body and finished with small pasta. Soak the chickpeas overnight.

steps.text: Soak the chickpeas in water overnight and drain.
Fry the roughly chopped onion in olive oil until soft but not golden. Add the tomatoes and rosemary sprig, season with salt and fry lightly.
Add the chickpeas and fry lightly. Add the white wine and cook over high heat until the liquid reduces.

Add the water, bring to the boil and cook over low heat until the chickpeas are completely soft. Remove 2 full ladles of chickpeas and blend in a food processor, adding a little of the soup liquid. Return the puree to the pot and bring to the boil again.
Add the pasta and cook in the soup until done. Serve with a drizzle of olive oil and chopped parsley if you like.
